signal: REBA adopted Microsoft Fabric in Nov 2025 and acquired Markerr in Dec 2025, adding public rent data and predictive modeling to its multifamily analytics platform

email.body1:
Tina, saw REBA adopted Microsoft Fabric and acquired Markerr to deepen its multifamily market intelligence.

A new acquisition plus a platform upgrade usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for REBA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tina, quick follow-up for REBA.

With Markerr folded in and a broader data offering, the cross-sell expectation on business development tends to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings REBA needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tina, last bit of proof for REBA.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how REBA's reply rate likely compares to other real-estate analytics companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tina, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition and a new data platform is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to REBA either way.
